text:
alex_w: PSA — PR #40982 updates eviction defaults and a readonly toggle for model KV cache. Planning canary tomorrow AM. Need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes. Tagging: @cheng_li @taylor_r @maria_g
maria_g: quick q — does this change affect batch sizes? can you paste the config diff?
alex_w: short diff below:
```yaml
cache:
  kv_capacity_mb: 512  # was 256
  eviction_policy: lru
  readonly_mode: true
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024  # unchanged
```
cheng_li: I can look in ~1hr. main concern: readonly true might surface latent cache misses; do we have metrics for miss rate? :thinking_face:
taylor_r: putting this on my radar. security: readonly_mode toggles write path off, but we need to ensure KMS audit still captures reads. pinging @security for signoff.
sre-bot: scheduled canary window: 2026-03-19 09:00-10:00 UTC — please ack if you want to adjust.
maria_g: quick suggestion: instead of flipping readonly globally, can we rollout in stages via feature flag? less blast radius.
alex_w: yes; PR includes flagging via `--kv-readonly-rollout` and a rollout plan in the description. i'll add a short canary step for 10% traffic.
taylor_r: ok pls add a security checklist item and tag me when updated. i'll do runtime perf smoke.
cheng_li: I pulled the branch, left 1 minor comment on test coverage. after that I can lgtm.
alex_w: thanks — I'll respond to comments and add the checklist. aiming to merge after canary if no regressions. :thumbsup:
taylor_r: acked. tagging infra for capacity: @infra-team — will 512MB per instance be OK for peak? need cost signal.
maria_g: cc @finance for cost heads up, small increase but temporary during rollout.
alex_w: updated PR with test and security checklist link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/40982
sre-bot: reminder in 30m for canary kickoff.
cheng_li: lgtm (after my tiny test nit).
